How should a synthetic extension explain parser warnings?

The question asks how a browser extension should explain parser warnings when a page has weak structure, missing metadata, or login-like copy.

Accepted answer

The accepted answer says the interface should describe uncertainty with plain language and keep the original page available. It recommends separating extraction status from model analysis so readers can understand what was actually parsed.
